description: Election Commission - Notify the name of Namadagaswewa Sugathasoma Thero as a member of the Pasbage Korale .Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a party member ceasing membership. This content falls squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) as it concerns electoral procedures and declarations related to local government elections.
